title: Authoritative Evidence-Boundary Reconciliation of Pre-P3 Artifact and Physical State
doctrine: A current filesystem hash matching the current manifest proves current file integrity. It does NOT automatically prove pre-P3 artifact content equality unless an explicit pre-P3 artifact was preserved, recovered, and directly compared byte-for-byte.
